input: Sync all contacts from old phone to new

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user may want all contacts, or only certain ones (e.g. personal but not work); duplicates may need to be handled; contact details like notes or photos may or may not be included.
Knowing whether this is for themselves or helping someone else (e.g. a parent) changes the level of technical guidance needed.
The operating systems of both phones (iOS, Android, or mixed) fundamentally determine which transfer methods are available.
The old phone's condition (working, broken screen, no SIM, dead battery) may limit which methods are feasible.
Whether the user has access to a computer, cables, or specific apps changes the practical transfer path.
Some users prefer a cloud-based method (Google, iCloud) while others want a direct, offline transfer — this shapes the recommended approach.
The user may consider the task done once contacts appear on the new phone, or may also need them verified, deduplicated, and backed up.

gold.taskTitle: Sync all contacts from old phone to new
gold.taskDescription: Transfer the full contacts list from an old phone to a new phone, ensuring nothing is lost in the process.

questions.title: What operating systems are on both phones?
questions.description: Identify the OS of the old phone (iOS/Android/other) and the new phone (iOS/Android/other), as this is the single biggest factor in which transfer method is viable.

questions.title: Is the old phone still fully functional?
questions.description: Determine whether the old phone powers on, has a working screen, and can connect to Wi-Fi or a cable — a damaged phone severely limits transfer options.

questions.title: Should every contact transfer, or only a selected group?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is a complete transfer of all contacts or a filtered subset (e.g. personal only, excluding duplicates, or specific groups).

questions.title: Are you doing this for yourself or helping someone else?
questions.description: Establish who the end user is, as helping a less tech-savvy person requires simpler, more guided steps versus a self-directed transfer.

questions.title: Do you have a computer and USB cable available?
questions.description: Find out what physical tools and equipment are on hand, since some transfer methods require a computer or cable while others are entirely wireless.

questions.title: Do you prefer a cloud sync or a direct device-to-device transfer?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is comfortable using a cloud account (Google, iCloud, Samsung) or prefers a local, offline method with no data going through a server.

questions.title: Should contacts also be deduplicated and backed up after transfer?
questions.description: Determine what 'done well' looks like — whether the task ends when contacts appear on the new phone, or includes verifying, cleaning duplicates, and creating a backup.
